published.source: Hunter ruling 2026-10-25 (standards 23: Mark duty assumed, every hunter keeps up its own Hunter's Mark and the raid's is off; was 1059.3)

summary: Marksmanship with Lone Wolf (+20% damage with no pet out). It beats a cat because a Forever pet takes no player buffs.
rotation: Pre-pull: Aspect of the Hawk at -3s, walk to 12 yd, Hunter's Mark at -1.5s, Rapid Fire at -0.1s
Rapid Fire, racials, potions and Demonic Rune on cooldown
Hunter's Mark (rank 4, +143 ranged attack power) 1.5s before the pull and again in its last 3s; the raid's mark is off
Scorpid Sting (2% off the boss's hit, 9% of base mana) at the pull and again in its last 2s, in place of Serpent Sting; the raid's Scorpid Sting is off
Arcane Shot on cooldown (above Aimed Shot, no mana floor)
Aimed Shot on the cooldown it shares with Multi-Shot (mana >= 40%)
Sniper Shot on cooldown while mana >= 10 x seconds left
Melee weave: between Auto Shots, walk in for a main hand swing with Raptor Strike queued when the next Auto Shot waits 1.2s or less and the shot cooldowns stay down, while mana >= 25 x seconds left
caveats: Assumed: Trueshot Aura's top rank gives 100 ranged attack power (the client has 50). Hunter's Mark gives 143, the server hotfix (the client has 71).
Aspect of the Hawk stays at rank 5 (90 RAP). Forever's rank 6 gives only 55.
Arcane Shot takes 10% of ranged attack power and Serpent Sting 3% a tick (beta log fit: 11% and 3.5%).
Auto Shot fires through casts and winds up 0.5s, which moving cancels.
Wildstalker Armor 4-piece and 5-piece aren't active. They would add 17.
Rapid Killing never triggers on a single boss.
Assumed: 22% more crit per Agility than Classic.
A 2.5s bow at Rhok'delar's 44.0 DPS. A 2.6s gun sims 0.3 to 1.0 higher with a 15% ammo pouch, 3.4 to 5.2 lower with Era's 14% pouch.
Costs 109.3 / 98.9 / 71.4 DPS vs Lone Wolf at 120s / 180s / 300s, mostly Serpent Sting's damage.
The sting only lowers the boss's hit by 2%. It adds no raid damage.
Mark duty is assumed: the hunter keeps up its own Hunter's Mark, and the raid's mark is off. That costs about 0.5 to 2.5 DPS at 180s.
notes: Request is hunter__lone-wolf's with the rotation swapped for ui/hunter/apls/lw_scorpid.apl.json (tools/rotopt/hunter_presets.sh) and debuffs.scorpidSting and debuffs.huntersMark removed (it keeps up its own Hunter's Mark, standards 23); mksettings writes the same raid as spec hunter_lw_scorpid. Request written by mksettings (spec hunter_lw, the hunter_presets.sh rotation); it matches the shipped preset's gear, talents, APL, race, consumes, raid buffs, debuffs and professions. Pet set to none (petType omitted = PetNone).
